topps_chrome_basketball_2025_26.release: Main set Nov 2025 (299-card base). Separate 'Topps Chrome Updates' Aug 2026 (see next key).
topps_chrome_basketball_2025_26.source: checklistinsider.com/2025-26-topps-chrome-basketball (odds table quoted from Topps sell sheet)

parallels.name: Refractor

Earlier search snippets claiming 'Ray Wave Magenta /399' were wrong. In the main set, RayWave starts at Yellow /275. In Chrome Updates, RayWave Magenta is /299 (Mega).

topps_football_flagship_2026.release: Aug 21, 2026. This is the first Topps flagship football set since 2015. I found NO '2025 Topps Football' paper flagship. A 'Vintage Stock /99 RC' is almost certainly from this 2026 set.

topps_disney_neon_2026.release: Apr 17, 2026. The 200-card base is NOT a Chrome product (it uses foil parallel names). A 100-card 'Chrome Neon-Etch' subset is chrome.

10: Black Speckle Refractor (Chrome Neon-Etch, per Tradercracks)
5: Neon Red Lava Refractor (Chrome Neon-Etch, per Tradercracks)

notes: I found no '2025 Topps Chrome Disney Neon'. 'Neon' is a separate 2026 Topps (non-Chrome) Disney product, and its chrome subset is called 'Neon-Etch'.
